subject: ela
skillName: Identify front cover and title page
intro: Books have parts. The front cover is the first page you see, with the title. The back cover is at the end. The title page inside shows the title and the author. Kindergartners find these parts.

items.prompt: Which part of a book do you see FIRST and has the title?

steps: The first page you see is the front cover.
So the front cover comes first.

items.prompt: Which part is at the very END of a book?

steps: The last outside page is the back cover.
So the back cover is at the end.

items.prompt: Which page inside shows the title and the author's name?

steps: The page inside with the title and author is the title page.
So it is the title page.
The front cover shows the title.

items.prompt: The back cover is at the ____ of the book.

steps: The back cover is at the end.

items.prompt: The ____ page shows the title and author inside.
